title: Review of the plan
intro_html: This form has one card for each item that needs your review or your decision. Read a card, then answer below it. Your answers are saved inside this HTML file.

labels.name: TESTED
labels.meaning: A script or a test ran and its output is saved.

labels.name: READ
labels.meaning: Found by reading the code or a document.

labels.name: INFERRED
labels.meaning: A conclusion from reasoning. Not tested.

sections.title: Part A — Findings
sections.intro: Each card is one finding. Tell me if you agree with it and with the proposed action.

sections.title: Part B — Decisions only you can make
sections.intro: Select one option for each decision. The recommended option has a mark.

sections.title: Part C — For your information
sections.intro: Nothing to decide here. Mark each card as noted, or write a comment.

choices.label: Agree with the problem, but change the action
